display.purpose: 页面主标题，如「创建策略」。

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #181a20; background: #fcd535; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f0b90b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #3a3a1f; color: #707a8a; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Pact Preview Panel
components.description: 创建策略页右侧 sticky 预览。
components.html:

components.css: .ds-pact-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #1e2329; border-radius: 8px; color: #fff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; max-width: 380px; } .ds-pact-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; padding: 16px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #2b3139; } .ds-pact-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip { font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px; background: #2b3139; color: #0ecb81; } .ds-pact-panel dl { padding: 16px 20px; margin: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-pact-panel dt { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #929aa5; margin-top: 12px; } .ds-pact-panel dt:first-child { margin-top: 0; } .ds-pact-panel dd { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #eaecef; } .ds-mono { font-family: JetBrains Mono, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-pact-panel .ds-btn-primary { margin: 0 20px 20px; width: calc(100% - 40px); }

components.name: Console Top Nav
components.html: YieldAgent控制台创建策略Pact 管理
components.css: .ds-top-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; background: #0b0e11; border-bottom: 1px solid #2b3139; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { color: #fcd535; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link { color: #707a8a; font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 2px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-link:hover { color: #eaecef; } .ds-link--on { color: #fff; border-bottom-color: #fcd535; }

components.name: Dark Input
components.description: 表单字段，如画布色输入框。
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="例如：500" aria-label="最大支出" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; max-width: 280px; height: 40px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: JetBrains Mono, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #fff; background: #0b0e11; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #707a8a; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #2b3139; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.5); }

components.name: Status Chip Pending
components.css: .ds-chip-pending { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #929aa5; background: #2b3139; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: YieldAgent 是以 Pact 为先的中文 Agent 控制台。设计 token 实现在 app/assets/css/main.css，经 Tailwind 映射到 Vue 组件。已交付创建策略分栏页与顶栏导航。
keyCharacteristics: 深色画布 canvas；界面文案 zh-CN
黄色仅用于主 CTA 与哈希链接
JetBrains Mono 用于可复制的数字与哈希
创建策略：左表单 + 右 sticky Pact 预览
prefers-reduced-motion 已在 main.css 处理
